# Local browser dependencies

Pinned npm distributions: marked 18.0.13 (MIT), DOMPurify 3.4.15 (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0), MathJax 3.2.2 (Apache-2.0). Original license files are included beside each distribution. Only the browser bundles and MathJax CHTML fonts are shipped. No runtime CDN requests are required. Do not edit minified vendor code by hand.
